exposure: No prenatal diagnosis of vasa previa
cohort: 157 pregnant women (131 singletons, 23 twins, and 3 triplets) with vasa previa at a tertiary hospital in west China between January 1, 2013 and December 31, 2019
finding: Neonatal mortality was significantly higher in cases with no prenatal diagnosis of vasa previa, while prenatal diagnosis was associated with higher rates of NICU admission, premature birth, and neonatal pneumonia.
